summary: Iteration 4 testing: validated new 'Le Livre du Soir' feature. Backend: added 3 pytest tests for /api/livre-du-soir + /api/livre-du-soir/history; full suite 23/23 passed (regression clean). Frontend: home card [data-testid=home-livre-du-soir] renders between ribbon and bento with Moon badge, greeting ('Ce que la bibliothèque vous propose ce soir :'), status badge, title (Nostradamus), subtitle, excerpt and 'Lire la chronique' link; navbar has [data-testid=nav-livre-du-soir]. /livre-du-soir renders formatted French date ('mercredi 16 septembre'), greeting, hero card [data-testid=livre-du-soir-card] with badge/title/excerpt, 'Lire la chronique' link [data-testid=livre-du-soir-open], and 'Garder pour plus tard' button [data-testid=livre-du-soir-fav]. Favorite toggle changes label 'GARDER POUR PLUS TARD' -> 'DANS MA BIBLIOTHÈQUE'. History section [data-testid=livre-du-soir-history] shows exactly 6 previous-day cards (today excluded). Regression routes /voyage /origine /frise /carte /univers/histoire-secrete all render without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is growing (~430 lines) with mixed concerns (catalog, panoramas, origines, livre-du-soir, AI). Consider splitting into routers/modules before the next feature.

_pick_for_date uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() — deterministic per UTC day; users in negative UTC offsets may see the story change at their local afternoon/evening. Consider a configurable TZ (e.g. Europe/Paris) to align with 'Livre du soir' semantics.
LivreDuSoirPage.jsx: silent .catch(() => {}) hides fetch errors — add a lightweight error state so users are not stuck on 'Chargement…' indefinitely on API failure.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 23 pytest tests (3 new for livre-du-soir: today, deterministic-repeat, history=7 ordered desc with today first). Frontend validated on desktop viewport 1920x4000. Determinism verified by two sequential GETs returning same story id. History returns 7 entries but the UI hides today (past = history.slice(1)) -> shows 6 cards which matches requirement.
